theme: A Maine medical day, with tomorrow's surgery to get ahead of.
greeting: The girls are with Jen this week, so today belongs to Mike's appointments and getting set for his surgery tomorrow.

needsAttention.title: Stock up before Mike's surgery tomorrow
needsAttention.detail: Mike's oral surgery is tomorrow in Portland. Today is the last window to fill prescriptions, lay in soft food, and grab ice packs and gauze — the prep task has been open since Aug 14.

needsAttention.title: Pick a time with Eugenia
needsAttention.detail: For your PRI catch-up, Eugenia offered Monday 12–2, or Thursday 7–11 and 12–2 your time. She's waiting on you to choose a slot.

flagged.title: Morgan Stanley corporate action notice
flagged.detail: A voluntary corporate action notice arrived via ProxyVote — worth a look in case there's an election deadline.

flagged.title: Mastercard's policy chief wants to connect
flagged.detail: A LinkedIn invite from Tucker, Chief Government Affairs & Policy Officer at Mastercard.

flagged.title: NACD New England reception, Sept 15
flagged.detail: An RSVP request for the chapter's appreciation reception.

flagged.title: Peter messaged you on LinkedIn
flagged.detail: A message is sitting in your LinkedIn inbox awaiting a reply.

inbox.noise: The usual promos and newsletters — Responsible Investor, Daily Italian, StoryGraph, and a few shopping pings.

resolved.title: IMC research call is locked in
resolved.detail: Mike Lubrano sent the Teams invite; you, Mike and Chie meet tomorrow at 9 PM your time.

resolved.title: Amra answered on Sustainalytics
resolved.detail: BlackRock's Amra Balic replied to your question about Morningstar winding down Sustainalytics' stewardship business.

recipe.title: Composed summer salad with french feta
recipe.why: High summer on the Maine coast has the farmstands at their peak, and a composed salad lets ripe tomatoes and briny French feta carry a warm, low-effort evening on your own.

acts.line: The day opens with Mike's 9:30 throat ultrasound — you're along for the medical run.
His brain MRI lands at 3:30, then a haircut at five before the evening turns.
Tokyo calls at eight, and the last of the surgery prep is yours to close out.
